lines.say: I ranked the games on a free website. Number one shocked me.
lines.cap: I ranked the games on a FREE website. #1 shocked me.

lines.say: Neon Serpent. Snake, but it glows. B tier.
Safecracker. You crack a safe, pin by pin. A tier.
Flop Hoops. The players are made of noodles. A tier.
Axe Spin. One more throw, forever. S tier.
Hyperlane. Racing at three hundred fifty, in neon. S tier.
lines.cap: Hyperlane. Racing at 350, in neon. S tier.

lines.say: Bumper Brawl. Knock your friends out of the ring. S tier.
Lantern Keep. A tower defence where every tower is a lantern. S plus. Easy.
lines.cap: Lantern Keep. A tower defence where every tower is a lantern. S+ Easy.

lines.say: They're all free, on Pulsebox. Box dot pulseform dot org.
lines.cap: They're all free, on PULSEBOX. box.pulseform.org
